reference_ceiling_note: The press has reported a 24% ceiling on microcredit interest since 2019; MRA's own notification was not located, so the current value is unconfirmed. Used only as a reference line, never as a compliance check.

screening_rule.note: MFIs with operating self-sufficiency below 100% and borrowing at or above 50% of loan outstanding. A filter on financial-structure ratios, not a measure of delinquency; reported as counts only, never as a named list.
